the-great-and-powerful-genie.text: Elijah Baran is a genie in a magic lamp who can grant three wishes. After thousands of years, a billionaire uses his last wish to grant Elijah freedom, but on one condition: Elijah must marry his granddaughter, Christine, for five years! To fulfill the wish, Elijah transforms into a human, marries Christine, and secretly helps her become a successful CEO. However, Christine ignores and constantly belittles him during their marriage. When the five years are almost up, Elijah starts to realize that Christine might never truly love him. He decides to divorce her.

zero-to-alpha-return-of-the-wolf-king.text: In Zero to Alpha Return of the Wolf King movie, exiled for failing to awaken his wolf form, Nory trained twenty years under three Masters beyond Sacred Rank. Returning to see his mother, he enters the Clan Tournament, shatters the test stone, crushes every foe, and is revealed as the savior three Gold Leaders sought. When vampires invade, he slams the Legendary First Sire through seven walls. Learning his mother was injured saving him, he gathers three sacred relics to heal her. But crimson eyes in distant mist hint a greater threat.

sold-to-the-warlord-born-for-the-sky.text: In Sold to the Warlord Born for the Sky movie, a sheltered northern princess who was sold into marriage to the dragon-riding warlord of the brutal Blackclaw horde must decide whether surrendering to the man who bought her is her greatest betrayal or the only thing that can save her dying people.

brides-in-smoke.text: Best friends Ella and Leah married the Harper brothers, firefighter Charles and doctor Noah. On their third anniversary, Charles’s first love locks Ella inside a burning room. When Ella begs Charles for help, he brushes her off to find his ex's cat. Leah rushes in to rescue Ella and calls Noah to save Ella and her baby, but is met with mockery. Heartbroken and betrayed after years of miserable marriages, the best friends decide to file for divorce from the Harper brothers together.

abandoned-pawn-unrivaled-dragon-king.text: In Abandoned Pawn Unrivaled Dragon King movie, Owen — discarded heir of the Hull family, the one and only disciple of the master of the Dragon Knight Sanctum. He awakens the Ten Dragon God Marks and forges a soul-deep bond with Akura, bearer of the ancient Golden Dragon bloodline. Betrayed by his own family, stripped of his name, and tormented by the very Sanctum that should have been his home — when the buried truth finally breaks free, the outcast of old rises in the full wrath of a Dragon God and grinds every last humiliation to dust. From that moment on, the young dragonlord sets forth across the land with his dragon at his side, and the entire continent shudders as the sky itself begins to change.

the-lycan-s-savage-luna.text: Wren is labeled wolfless and abandoned by her childhood lover Tristan at his coronation, who publicly rejects their mate bond and lets his lover cut her hair. Heartbroken, she leaves the Dark Moon pack and enters the elite Apex Academy. There, she awakens the rare powerful White Wolf bloodline hidden inside her. With the quiet Frost heir Killian's support, Wren defeats rivals, uncovers Vaelen's evil plot that preys on wolfkin's blood power, and rescues her dad. She stands side by side with Killian to build a new order where no one is forced to kneel for power.

in-bed-with-my-brother-in-law.text: In In Bed with My Brother-in-Law movie, Bella's arranged marriage becomes a nightmare when she catches her fiancé cheating. Seeking revenge, she sleeps with a stranger, unwittingly bedding her fiancé's powerful mafia boss brother, Damian Gotti. Forced back into the Gotti family, Bella faces dangerous secrets and forbidden desires. Damian relentlessly pursues her under his brother's nose. Eventually, Damian exposes his brother's crimes, saves Bella, and they unite to defend their mafia throne.

shattered-vows.text: In Shattered Vows movie, princess Venessa lived a sheltered life—until her sister was murdered. Stripped of her innocence in a single night, she must confront a devastating betrayal: her husband and best friend just helped the killer escape justice. The pampered princess is gone. Now she's coming for every last one of them, to take back the justice they owe her sister.

my-billionaire-boss-won-t-let-me-quit.text: In My Billionaire Boss Won't Let Me Quit movie, seeking a fresh start after years of managing crises, Grace takes on a new job, only to be swept into a fake marriage by her enigmatic boss, Mason. As their pretend arrangement blurs into undeniable passion, Grace falls deeper into his spell. But Mason is playing a far more dangerous game—and he has no intention of ever letting her go.

the-valkyrie-divorces-the-god-of-war.text: In The Valkyrie Divorces the God of War movie, to protect his wife, God King Kairos sealed his divine powers and feigned being a worthless mortal. Instead of gratitude, Cassia returned bearing her lover's child, demanding the family relic while humiliating him publicly. Driven past his limit, Kairos shattered his shackles, awakening his supreme godhood. He exposed her lover as an abyssal spy, leading to the traitor's execution. Begging for mercy, Cassia fled in exile, as the God King reclaimed his absolute throne.

my-homeless-bride-is-a-culinary-legend.text: After claiming her fifth World Culinary Championship, the legendary Chef Sage goes undercover as a homeless beggar to find a partner with genuine character. Ignored by the masses and ruthlessly mocked by her ex, she encounters Jasper, a kind-hearted man who offers her his food. Desperate to save his family's failing restaurant from a vicious corporate takeover, Jasper hires Sage to play his wealthy fake fiancée. As rival factions push the Vance family to the brink with a high-stakes "Culinary Death Match," all hope seems lost. But when cornered, the beggar bride sheds her disguise. With a flash of her blade and her signature blue flame, she turns the tables against world-class chefs, exposing her true identity and sparking a legendary romance.

the-alpha-princess-is-gone-for-good.text: Pampered real alpha princess Evie is framed and sent to the ruthless Werewolf Military Academy by her own family. They believe she is living comfortably, completely unaware that under the fake alpha princess's orders, Evie suffers brutal abuse. Three years later, she returns, broken inside, yet her family still views her as a spoiled brat. It is only when her father strikes her and her prosthetic limb falls off that they finally realize the horrifying truth...

the-real-heiress-reclaims-her-place.text: Elena, the biological daughter of the wealthy Delaney family, was framed by her adopted sister Sarah in a car accident. Wrongfully accused of drunk driving, she was sentenced to ten years in prison. Nobody believed her. Famous sculptor Leo helped her take a new identity. Flora grew into a renowned sculptor. When she returned, Sarah accused her of being an ex-con and plagiarizing artworks. Flora fought back, exposing Sarah's lies. Sarah was the bastard daughter of Elena's dad. Sarah got punished. Flora cut ties with the cold family and started a new life with her lover Marc.

mated-to-the-alpha-and-his-beta.text: On mating night, Charlie is claimed by the Alpha and his Beta. By morning, she's publicly declared "unsatisfactory" and replaced. But when she discovers she can hear their private mind-link—and their chosen mate can't—the question becomes: if she was never meant for them, why is she the only one who feels the bond?

slimming-revolution.text: In Slimming Revolution Movie, Declan, the Harrison family's heir, marries Claire, the daughter of a wealthy tycoon, due to a family arrangement. However, on their wedding day, Declan is shocked to see that Claire, whom he's meeting for the first time, is a plus-size woman, nearly 300 pounds. The wedding guests quickly turn Declan into the laughingstock of the event. Reluctantly, Declan starts married life with this stranger, and Claire's intense love for him only adds to his stress. When Claire's efforts to protect their love inadvertently anger Declan, he, obsessed with appearances, cruelly takes out his frustrations on her, even criticizing her weight. Feeling deeply hurt, Claire decides to embark on a journey to lose weight, determined to make Declan regret his actions.

return-to-reckon-with-his-hateful-villag.text: In a small village divided by strict rules, a young man from the lower village fell in love with his childhood friend from the upper village. Unfortunately, their romance was discovered, leading to a ...

after-the-reformatory-my-family-begs-me-.text: When the Blaires turn Elena, the black sheep of the family, into a scapegoat to cover for their adoptive daughter's crimes, she is sent to a reform school to be tortured. Three years later, on the eve of her release, Elena just wants a fresh start—but her evil family has other plans.

do-me-over.text: Sarah Loren is a widow with a teenage son, Ethan Cole is a big shot CEO who wants to acquire her company. He is arrogant, brilliant, and unnecessarily good looking, and he'll stop at nothing to get what he wants, and what he wants… is Sarah's heart.

the-lady-boss-ceo-is-my-daughter.text: After Matilda's only daughter, Elodie, is rescued from her kidnapper by local police - she is turned over to foster care and never to be seen again. Matilda and her son, Carson, never stopped searching for her - spending every last penny on posters and PI invesitgations till they starved. Then, after twenty long years of desperate attempts to get Elodie back, she returns. Except, now she's Billionaire CEO Miss Atkins and her company is going to destroy the very home she grew up in - and the only remaining clue that could bring the family back together again.

torn-between-the-mafia-twins.text: She discovers her mob boss husband's affair and loses one of her twin babies due to his adopted sister's schemes. She reports him to the authorities and flees while still pregnant. Seven years later, she runs into him on the street. She thinks her murderous husband is going to kill her, but when he drags her back home against her will, she realizes the truth. Seven years ago, it was all a misunderstanding. The ruthless mafia boss only wants one thing—to win her love back.

once-love-is-lost-it-never-returns.text: After surviving a month of kidnapping and torture, Claire returns home with severe PTSD, only to be misunderstood and humiliated by her brother Maxwell and her family. As her trauma becomes impossible to ignore, Maxwell begins to doubt his judgment — but when Claire gives up on ten years of love and walks away, he finally realizes the truth was never what he believed.

little-miss-fortune.text: When James loses his daughter Amy and his legs on the same day, he stops believing in magic. Little does he know, Amy is now Mia, a fortune-telling prodigy come to save James from his fatal bad karma.

the-art-of-letting-go.text: When Olivia signs up for a life-saving surgery that will erase every memory - including the man who broke her heart - she's finally ready to walk away from her painful marriage. But with 14 days left on the clock, her cold, distant husband realizes too late what he's about to lose.

the-alpha-and-his-nanny-luna.text: Five years ago, Tiffany was betrayed by her fiancé and best friend, poisoned, and left for dead while pregnant. She survived, but her newborn daughter vanished without a trace. Desperate to find her, Tiffany takes a job as a nanny at the Silvermoon Pack, never realizing the little princess in her care is her own missing daughter. The girl's father is Asher Sterling—the ruthless, untouchable Alpha who has spent five years searching for the mysterious woman from his one unforgettable night. As Tiffany and Asher are drawn together, old enemies resurface, deadly secrets unravel...

thirsty-for-the-wet-nurse.text: No mate, no wolf, and raising a pup alone, Ella never expected one act of kindness to tie her fate to Alpha Torin, who is cursed to never touch a woman. When she becomes the wet nurse to his newborn heir, Ella is pulled into a deadly game of jealousy and betrayal inside the Alpha's keep.

crowned-in-silver-blood.text: After a devastating betrayal that decimates two powerful wolf packs, young Nora Reed is forced into a mating bond with Alpha Drake, her enemy, her savior, and the man who believes she's responsible for his family's death. For three years, Drake torments her, determined never to love her. But when he finally claims her body and then shoves her aside, Nora shatters. She cuts their magical soul-bond and disappears. Years later, she returns not as Nora Reed, but as Nadia Moon, heiress to a royal European pack, cloaked in wealth, power. Her mission is clear, protect her children, reclaim her power, and avoid Drake at all costs.

divorced-and-desired-my-trio-of-elite-su.text: In Divorced and Desired! My Trio of Elite Suitors movie, Ivory, a secret billionaire heiress, has invested her time and money in growing her husband. After three years of marriage, her husband, Nelson...

i-gave-my-wife-a-red-tasseled-spear.text: After three years on the battlefield, the wife returns victorious, but unexpectedly pregnant! The former Grand Marshal of the empire's army had retired due to his parents' last wishes and married a woman known for her bravery and ambition. She aspired to achieve greatness on the battlefield, and before she left, he gifted her a legendary spear forged from thousand-year-old cold iron. Three years later, she returns clad in silver armor, pregnant, and holding another man's hand. She presents a letter of divorce, declaring, "My husband must be a heroic figure who stands tall, not a weak scholar with no strength." Unbeknownst to her, the seemingly powerless man she had married was actually the empire’s guardian deity. When he dons his marshal armor once again and takes up his legendary weapon, she finally realizes the true identity of the man she once scorned.

alpha-s-regret-after-his-pregnant-luna-s.text: In Alpha's Regret After His Pregnant Luna's Death movie, Alpha Declan is tricked by his brother's treacherous widow, Olivia, into locking his pregnant Luna, Evelyn, in a Silver Cage for three days. He thought he was teaching her a lesson, but it was all part of Olivia's schemes to take Evelyn's place as Luna! Declan refuses to believe Evelyn, even as she begs him to save her, convinced it's all an act. He only realizes he's condemned his own Luna and their pup to death when he sees their dead bodies with his very own eyes.

the-billionaire-groom-exchange.text: Yvonne is murdered by her jealous sister right as she's giving birth. She wakes up one year in the past, the day they picked their husbands! Fiona remembers the "future" and chooses Oliver, who was Yvonne's husband. Yvonne picks Fiona's past/future wheelchair-bound husband, Ethan. What no one knows, is that Ethan is secretly the richest man in the world!

blitzed-by-my-rival-s-obsession.text: Sunny star quarterback Seth hides a love-starved heart behind his perfect facade. When violent ex-linebacker "Mad Dog" Matthew transfers into his team and becomes his forced roommate, their explosive fights bleed into charged, unbearable tension. Seth falls hard, until he spots his rival Ethan's birthday carved into Matthew’s necklace, convinced he's just a stand-in...

i-became-the-ceo-s-most-beloved.text: Erin Vance’s 18th wedding anniversary turns into a nightmare when she discovers her husband Derek cheating with her best friend Sofia. Betrayed and abandoned, Erin is forced to start over with nothing. With help from Gavin Bower, she enters the “Miss Intercontinental” contest and rises from a housewife to a champion through her talent and determination. Defeating Sofia and exposing her scandals, Erin rebuilds her life. Gavin, secretly the president of K Group, supports her while letting her prove herself. After overcoming betrayal and danger, Erin regains her dignity and begins a new chapter with Gavin.

this-child-is-a-legendary-sorcerer.text: Cole was the undisputed Supreme Sorcerer — until he died in a cataclysmic magical war. His soul reincarnated into the body of a young boy named Leo — a boy afflicted with a Death Curse, with little time left to live. The only hope: the Starlight Potion, guarded by the arrogant Westwood family. Leo’s mother, Clara, a powerless ordinary woman, humbled herself before the Westwoods, begging for the potion to save her son.They ridiculed her. Humiliated her. But Clara never backed down. Until Leo could take it no more.Something inside Leo shattered. A pressure so immense it cracked the marble floor exploded from his tiny frame. The entire Westwood mansion trembled. Every sorcerer in the room was forced to their knees — their faces pressed to the ground, unable to breathe, unable to speak. But no one knew: Clara herself had also been struck by the Death Curse. And in the end, for the sake of her child, she gave the only life-saving potion to Leo.

the-fake-dating-spell.text: One drunken night, one humiliating ex, fake-date her worst enemy Blake or watch the Greenharts lose every point because of her. Hannah signs the contract expecting torture. Instead, she finds the cold, untouchable rival everyone fears has a side no one's ever seen, fiercely protective, quietly devoted, and hiding a secret of his own. When the pretending stops feeling like pretending, is it still an act? Then her ex Tristan discovers the truth—Hannah is Miss H, the anonymous genius the whole school idolizes. Now he's on his knees, begging for a second chance. Two boys, one choice.

legally-bound-to-love.text: The story follows Leilani, whose adoptive father has been framed by her ex-boyfriend. Desperate for help, she turns to the one man she trusts the least—Diego Marlowe, a ruthless, undefeated attorney who also happens to be her enemy’s future brother-in-law. What begins as a dangerous deal and a fake relationship soon spirals into a high-stakes game of power, secrets, and irresistible attraction. As they use each other to navigate the battles surrounding them, one question lingers: Is Diego truly just her lawyer—or something far more dangerous to her heart?

caught-in-his-current.text: Leo, the legendary surfing champion, loses his title to a mysterious newcomer named Ruslan. But the biggest shock comes when he discovers that Ruslan is the man from his unforgettable night. Forced into an uneasy partnership, the two rivals find themselves drawn to each other as secrets, danger, and betrayal close in. Behind their battle for glory lies a hidden truth about Ruslan—and their forbidden desire has only just begun...

the-hobo-goddess-and-her-billion-dollar-.text: Everyone accuses Faye of being a gold-digging prostitute because of her hobo clothes. Little do they realize that she's the ONLY ONE who can cure the hottest and richest man in the nation - war hero, Adam Stone! (And win his heart too)

the-new-ceo-turns-out-to-be-my-gynecolog.text: Clara is trapped in a year‑long sexless marriage. She develops hypersexuality and seeks medical help—only to meet Dr. Killian, a domineering CEO‑physician who humiliates her during a full exam. That night, her husband Julian rejects her advance, and she discovers he gratifies himself to photos of her half‑sister Vivian—exposing the fraud of her marriage. The next day, Killian is revealed as her company's new CEO. He promotes her to his personal assistant, exploiting her condition with constant verbal and physical pressure. During a phone call from her own home, with Julian just outside the door, Killian pushes her into a hysterical orgasm, escalating their forbidden tension. Killian's possessiveness deepens. When his friend shows interest in Clara, he burns with jealousy. At a gala, as he helps her with her zipper, her hysteria ignites. Killian drops all pretense and declares he will "treat her" right there—their relationship teeters on the edge of an irreversible, physical turning point.

son-in-law-s-revenge.text: After being mistreated by his wife’s family for years, Leo discovers that he is the heir to a vast fortune. Now it’s time — for revenge!

a-cinderella-for-wolf-king.text: A destitute orphan Layla accidentally stumbles into the Wolf King Kai's suite, and one night soul-binds them. He throws a check at her. She rips it up and slaps him. A month later, Layla discovers she's pregnant with sextuplets. Her greedy stepfamily sells her for $100,000. Kai transforms into a silver wolf, rescues her, and declares her his destined mate. Layla joins K-Group on her own merit. Kai secretly courts her. But Kai's rumored fiancée Chloe humiliates Layla—until Kai breaks the engagement publicly. Chloe colludes with a dark warlock to sell Layla, revealing she's a sacred vessel to break the wolf clan's curse. Kai rescues her and exposes Chloe as an identity thief. Layla is the true Grey heiress, swapped at birth. Layla delivers sextuplets, ending the curse. From abandoned orphan to matriarch of two clans, she rises to become beloved by all.

ceo-that-intern-is-actually-your-wife.text: My billionaire CEO is my contract-married husband! My grandmother fell seriously ill, so I flash-married a stranger for her surgery fees. We entered a one-year contract marriage. I bumped into a handsome man, who I later found out was the CEO of the company I wanted to join! But little did I know, he was the man I married... As the contract period nears its end, we are supposed to divorce. However, both of us lost our marriage certificates. Now what do we do? Does this mean we can't get divorced after all?

alpha-revenge-wolf-king-and-his-human-lu.text: Her parents were cruelly killed by werewolves, yet she has now become the Fated Luna of the werewolf Alpha. However, their love defies werewolf traditions, sparking conflict as they face rogue wolves and ancient prophecies. With hidden powers and fierce rivalries at play, love, destiny, and power clash in this thrilling tale of passion and survival.

he-s-done-being-nice.text: "I'm Jason Hayes, and today, I am reborn. In my past life, I was weak. In this one, I choose to be the villain." From a humble waiter to the king of the underworld, Jason fights back against every bully and outmaneuvers the most powerful figures, including the father-in-law of a crime lord. His ironclad rule: touch what's mine, and you won't survive. Only when he stops stepping aside does Jason learn a brutal truth: the world makes way for those who refuse to move.

my-sister-stole-my-mate-so-i-married-a-k.text: At my own Mate Claim Ceremony, Cassian rejected me and took my sister Maris’s hand, claiming he only wanted to save her from the Council. Then he tried to rip my dead mother’s moonstone necklace from my neck so Maris could wear it as his chosen Luna. The chain broke. So did the last reason I had to wait for him. In three days, the Council would send me to Rowan Vale, the Lycan king’s dying heir. Everyone pitied me. But Rowan was the first man to ask if I chose him freely.

the-silver-serpent-s-bride.text: Raised on her Grandma's one unbreakable rule, stay away from serpents, she never expects to save a heavily wounded man in the forest. Little does she know, the man she's saved is the feared Silver Serpent King, Silvan. He's made up his mind and has marked her as his. On Bella's wedding day, he crashes the ceremony and declares her his in front of everyone. Desperate to escape this possessive monster, Bella decides to run away with her childhood sweetheart. But to her shock, the man she trusts most betrays her and offers her up as a sacrifice. Betrayed, hunted, and on the edge of death, the man she once feared most becomes the only one left protecting her.

the-heat-after-the-ac-died.text: Ever since their parents married, Becca has hated her stepbrother, Samir. For two years, she's blamed him for stealing her family, her home, and the life she lost. But when a brutal heatwave knocks out the AC, they’re trapped alone in a house that’s far too hot—and far too small. As Samir struggles to fix the broken air conditioner, lingering resentment gives way to lingering touches. The line between hate and desire begins to disappear, and Becca must face the one truth. She's spent years denying that the man she's forbidden to want may be the only one she can't resist.

my-househusband-is-gamble-king.text: Gamble King Harold hid his identity, protecting the Daltons and taking care of Grace for three years as his master Victor Dalton begged him before he passed away. However, his silent protection was only repaid with contempt and ridicule. Harold endured it all until only three days remained. But Grace was tricked by her friend, and it seemed that the Dalton family would suffer heavy losses. Harold used his gambling skills to defeat the evil rivals. After that, Harold left. When Grace knew Harold's departure, she panicked and searched everywhere for his whereabouts.

a-farm-girl-s-reckoning.text: In A Farm Girl's Reckoning movie, bound by her late father's dying wish, ex-special forces soldier Hanna Carter buried her past and settled into quiet farm life, marrying Jake and raising their five kids together. For years his family lived off her sacrifice. Then Jake turned on her, showing up with his mistress to demand a divorce while his family schemed to steal the farm and throw Hanna and her children out. Cornered at last, Hanna stops holding back — and Jake's family realizes too late she was never just a farm girl.

reborn-to-rule-the-sky-with-my-dragon.text: Briar gave everything to her elite dragon flight and her fiancé, Silas. Her reward? Betrayal. They mocked her unawakened dragon as a useless runt, stripped her of her rank, and left her to die. But death didn't take. Reborn back to a few days ago, Briar turns her back on her toxic ex. While they laugh at her "weak" dragon, Briar is ready to unleash a mythical power unseen for centuries. When the skies clash, Silas will realize too late: they didn't just discard a useless teammate—they threw away the goddess of victory.

the-extraordinary-mother-of-a-billionair.text: Roger, chairman of the trillion-dollar group WestDream, wantsto do something special for his single mother and introduce his fiancée Vivian to her, so he brings his mother Susan, who works at a small-town restaurant, to the city to celebrate her birthday. However, Vivian’s cousin Lisa, unaware of Susan’s true identity, mistakes Susan for a thief and humiliates her. Later, Susan is again targeted by her future daughter-in-law Vivian, who treats Susan as a fraud and humiliates her. Susan tries again and again to defend herself, but no one listens.After suffering repeated humiliation, she is finally rescued by Roger. Only then does everyone realize that the humble Susan really is Roger’s mother. But by then, it is too late for regret. Roger resolves to punish the villains who bullied his mother and help her regain her dignity.

the-royals.text: When the British heir dies suddenly, a modern royal family spirals into chaos. Party-loving twins Prince Liam and Princess Eleanor are forced to grow up fast—Liam is thrust toward the crown while falling for Ophelia, the palace security chief’s American daughter, and Eleanor hits rock bottom after a dangerous betrayal. As King Simon grieves and the monarchy teeters, ruthless Queen Helena joins forces with scheming Prince Cyrus to keep control at any cost. A dynasty built on glamour is about to face its darkest reckoning. Buy full season: https://www.lionsgate.com/shows/the-royals/the-royals-season-1

he-chose-my-sister-so-i-chose-the-serpen.text: Olivia saved Adam, the silent serpent shapeshifter no one wanted, and spent years nursing him back to health. Yet when fire trapped her and her sister Chloe, Adam chose Chloe and left Olivia to die. Reborn on the day the twin serpent guards are chosen, Olivia gives both brothers to Chloe and fights her way into the family business. When Chloe arranges Olivia's kidnapping, Adam once again sacrifices her safety for Chloe's birthday. But this time, Olivia has planned her escape. Declared dead, she becomes the secret ally of Jason Astor, the ruthless Serpent King and her family's greatest enemy. As Olivia destroys the family that treated her as disposable, Adam returns desperate for forgiveness, only to find she no longer belongs to him.

the-rockstar-s-secret.text: In The Rockstar's Secret movie, Juniper is hopelessly, recklessly in love with Tristan—the dark, intoxicating rockstar who rules their campus. The catch? He’s her protective older brother Carter’s best friend, and as far as Tristan is concerned, Juniper is nothing more than an invisible little sister. Until the night the lights go out. Trapped in the pitch-black darkness, a wild, uninhibited flame ignites between them—a night of unforgettable passion with a mysterious girl whose face Tristan never saw. All he has to trace his secret lover is a delicate butterfly bracelet left behind, and the vivid memory of a butterfly birthmark. He is obsessively hunting for the stranger who shattered his world, unaware that the girl he craves is sitting right across his kitchen table. But if Tristan discovers Juniper was the woman in the dark, and if Carter finds out his best friend touched his sister, the fallout could destroy them all. Can a love born in the shadows survive the brutal light of truth?

the-alpha-king-s-true-heiress.text: Sold to a drug lord by her foster father, Aurora leaps from a tower and is reborn. She exposes the Harrisons' abuse, then her sealed wolf awakens, revealing her as Alpha King Vincent's long-lost daughter. Vincent brings Aurora home to a noble academy where she crushes every challenger. Three adopted brothers discover they are all her destined mates. At her coronation, Aurora exposes the Harrisons' crimes and Vincent banishes them. All three brothers declare love, leaving her choice open.

offered-to-the-triplet-alpha.text: Xanthea Plath, an illegitimate child of the Alpha of Virgo pack, was an omega and omegas weren't allowed to dream, yet she never stopped dreaming. She wanted to be a doctor just like her mother but the luna of the pack, her stepmother would break her physically and mentally and stop at nothing to crush all her dreams. Xanthea had still found a way though all the abuse her steps put her through. But one day her world came crashing down right before her entrance in a medical college when she found out that she was being offered as a bride to the ruthless triplet alphas also known as the demon lords of the Infernal pack of the underworld. Xanthea had heard the horrifying stories of several suitors who had come before her, all of whom had met a gruesome end.

traded-my-wolves-for-a-snake.text: Cora took in three wounded wolves and raised them. The moment her sister Vivian appeared, the wolves couldn't look away—they turned cold and rough, trying to break Cora. She overheard them mocking her. So she offered a trade: three wolves for Vivian's snake. Silas the snake was ice-cold, yet he stayed—doing chores, guarding her. When her family forced an arranged marriage, Cora faked agreement, then fled through a window on her wedding day. Silas tracked her to the airport, injuring two wolves who tried to stop him. “You'll never get rid of me,” he said. Cora took over the family business and bonded with Silas. The cold snake was truer than any wolf.

the-professor-s-forbidden-dragon-prey.text: At Asgard Academy, underdog Elena is relentlessly bullied for her pathetically weak magic. Ice-cold, stoic Professor Cassius notices her for one thing. Her scent feels hauntingly familiar, and it inexplicably awakens his long-sealed curse mark. He offers her private tutoring as cover, helping her rein in her wildly unstable magic. Until he makes the shocking discovery...

full-court-legend.text: In 2006, Marcel "The Sniper" Wallace wins THE LEAGUE title, then loses his wife to rival Tyler Murray's hitman. He vanishes into a fast-food job for twenty years. Lured back as coach, he reunites with his resentful son Mars, a LEAGUE star. Marcel proves himself through impossible shots while Murray escalates to kidnapping and blackmail. At the Hall of Fame, Marcel reveals his identity and Murray confesses to murder. Victory comes when Mars accepts twenty unsent birthday letters and they embrace.

i-m-pregnant-it-s-not-yours.text: In I’m Pregnant It’s Not Yours movie, husband prefers secretary, who looks like his white moonlight, over his wife Iris. Calmly, Iris asks for a divorce, revealing that the baby she's carrying isn't his. Five years later, she returns powerfully with her new flame, while Husband is left drowning in regret.

mafia-s-desire-for-the-wet-nurse.text: Elena is drugged by her stepfather and, at a masked ball, has a night with Vincent—a powerful heir who can't touch any woman due to childhood trauma. She gives birth to Leo, but Frank sends the baby to an orphanage. Vincent recognizes his tie at the scene, adopts Leo, and brings him home. Desperate to reclaim her child, Elena applies as a wet nurse at Cunningham Manor, reuniting with Vincent—neither recognizes the other. Leo only drinks Elena's milk. Vincent discovers Elena is the only woman he can touch without repulsion, and gradually falls for her. Frank's schemes and Lina's sabotage are repeatedly thwarted by Vincent. Elena learns her child has been "adopted" by the Clintons, but discovers the child isn't hers—the orphanage director was deceiving her. Vincent produces the tie: Leo is her son, and Vincent is the masked man from that night. Vincent confronts his father Charles, exposing the abuse that drove his mother to suicide. Charles concedes, accepting Elena. The family of three reunites in a grand wedding.

offside-with-the-hockey-star.text: At Waverly University, the ice rink is split in two: on one side, the hockey team trains with brutal intensity; on the other, the figure skating team glides through elegant routines. Abby Williams is the golden girl of the ballet-on-ice program — obedient, disciplined, and desperate to land the lead role of the Black Swan in the Winter Showcase. There's just one problem: she has no idea how to be "bad." Enter Tristan Beaumont, the university's most notorious playboy and captain of the hockey team — reckless, magnetic, and hiding a devastating secret behind his bad-boy reputation. When Abby asks him to teach her how to unleash her dark side, neither of them expects what happens next: a forbidden attraction neither can control. Standing between them is Taylor Beaumont, Tristan's younger brother — Abby's skating partner, her best friend, and the "good" Beaumont everyone expects her to choose. As rumors, sabotage, and a jealous rival threaten to destroy everything Abby has worked for, she must decide who she really wants — and who she's willing to fight for. Torn between two brothers, a forbidden romance, and the role of a lifetime, Abby will learn that becoming the Black Swan means learning to stop following the rules — and start listening to her heart.

my-fireplace-ships-to-dragon-realm.text: Wealthy heiress Emily is hunted down by her relatives over her massive inheritance. She flees to her family’s rural farm for shelter, only to accidentally discover that their fireplace connects to a dragon‑ruled otherworld. She keeps sending modern supplies to this realm, aiding Kael, the metal dragon lord, in protecting his people and homeland. To the dragons, she becomes the "Dragon God". From firewood and medicine to modern weaponry, she reshapes the dragon‑race war step by step — and rewrites her own destiny.

fated-to-his-brother-s-alpha.text: Luca Conri is the wolf-less runt of the Nightreign Pack, whose bark is bigger than his bite. Tormented by his own pack and hunted by rivals, Luca is reluctantly put under the protection of his dominant Alpha, and older brother's best friend, Dalton. However, everything changes when the two become fated mates, a bond that violates the natural order of the pack. As enemies close in and traditions try to tear them apart, Luca and Dalton must decide if they want to give into their lustful temptations in a forbidden romance that threatens their own lives.

the-son-rises-alone.text: Sawyer is a quarterback prodigy, but his mom Marnie always ignores him in favor of his adopted brother, Ben, even when Ben frames Sawyer, steals his MVP title, and ruins his future. Heartbroken, Sawyer vows to make his mom realize just how much she hurt him and how much she's lost.

i-married-the-groom-s-uncle.text: On her wedding day, Jagger Hamilton abandons Avery for his adopted sister Tatum. Jagger's uncle Beckett, Manhattan's feared "Ice Blade," marries her instead. Three years later, Avery carries Beckett's long-awaited child, but Jagger and Tatum return and brutally kill the baby. Beckett exacts brutal revenge, crippling and disowning them. Years later, Avery and Beckett welcome a healthy son, while a ruined, disabled Jagger—rejected by the family—takes his own life.

the-ugly-girl-turned-pretty.text: Tessa’s crush throws her cinnamon roll in the trash and calls her a fat pig in front of the whole class. When she finally stops begging to be chosen, she starts glowing up and catches everyone’s eye, including the boy who destroyed her. But Tessa has already chosen Adrian, the masked outcast everyone calls scarred and pathetic. By the time Chase wants her back, Adrian’s secret is out: he was never weak. He was the richest, most dangerous boy in the room.

t-boning-my-f1-rival.text: Ryder and Enzo, F1 rivals for fourteen years, one from the slums, one a billionaire heir. Enzo whispers "I love you" during CPR; Ryder wakes convinced it was sabotage. Handcuffs, saunas, and blindfold drills force them close as Ryder battles desire. Enzo risks his life against a violent rival and quietly pays Ryder's mother's surgery. They confess at the track where it began. In the final race, Enzo pushes Ryder to victory with his own car and crashes. In the wreckage, Ryder says "I love you."

sss-rank-the-slum-born-thunder-god.text: To the world, Nate Ryder is a failure whose Awakening ended in disgrace. But Nate knows the truth: he awakened the SSS-rank Thunder God—the rarest power on Earth. His father sold his health for a vial of Awakening serum. His mother has been paralyzed for ten years, yet she's the reason he never gives up. At school, the elite bully Tyler—an A-rank prodigy—crushes that serum and works with corrupt administrators to bar Nate from the national tournament. Facing relentless humiliation, Nate hides his power and bides his time. Every insult, every injustice becomes fuel for his training. Then the Federal Awakened Selection Tournament begins. Tyler, determined to defeat Nate in front of thousands, steps into the arena—expecting a hopelessly one-sided fight. Instead, Nate unleashes his SSS-rank Thunder God. In one electrifying moment, the "worthless failure" shocks the world—and begins his unstoppable rise to the top.

tempted-by-my-step-son.text: After his mother’s death, billionaire heir Vincent became reckless, cold, and impossible to control. But everything snaps when his father Arthur brings home a mysterious woman who looks exactly like Vincent’s late mother — and even gives her his mother’s priceless jewels. Convinced Evelyn is a manipulative gold digger, Vincent sets out to expose her. But inside an abandoned greenhouse wrapped in vines, he uncovers her darkest secret… and a dangerous attraction neither of them can resist.

his-partner-her-revenge.text: Ava Russell on the eve of her arranged marriage, is drugged by her fiancé Nico Moretti and has her hair brutally shaved off by his comrade Scarlett. Refusing to swallow this humiliation, Ava secretly contacts Damian Costello, the powerful heir of the Costello family who has secretly loved her for twelve years. On the wedding day, when Nico tries to sneak Ava into his family through a shabby, hidden ceremony and Scarlett publicly strips off her wig to mock her, Damian arrives with a magnificent fleet to marry Ava in style. With the help of Damian and the Commission, Nico and Scarlett are stripped of their power and arrested for violating family laws, while Ava finally finds her true protector and happiness.

the-auctioned-mate.text: Kaelen Ashfell bought me at the Mate Auction for a fortune. Three years later, after I gave him three hatchlings, his first love came back, and he crossed my name out of his Bond Ledger like I was property to return. He handed me and our babies to his brother Roran, then let his first love tear apart my den, my garden, and even hurt our child. Kael thought regret could bring me back. But the mate he discarded was about to learn what it felt like to be protected by someone else.

art-of-falling-in-love.text: A mural artist and an architectural engineer are instantly drawn to each other, but their budding romance comes to a halt when the past comes back to haunt them.

daddy-we-re-done.text: For ten years, janitor Maya scrimps and saves while raising her daughter Lily almost entirely on her own—only to discover that her husband, Adrian, is actually a multimillionaire who has lavished all his love and affection on his first love and her son. Completely heartbroken, Maya leaves with Lily. She is later revealed to be the daughter of a fallen war hero, and after reclaiming her true identity, she becomes the long-lost beloved heiress of the powerful Harrington family. When Adrian loses his business, his family, and the wife and daughter he took for granted, he falls to his knees and begs for forgiveness. Lily gives him only one final answer: “Daddy, we’re done.”

forbidden-bonds-fated-to-the-ocean-god.text: For years, demigod Elena endured the arrogance and cruelty of Alec, Sovereign of Olympus—only to have him reject her on her eighteenth birthday. But fate gives her a second chance when she meets Stefano, the powerful King of the Titans. His choice is immediate and public, "I want her. No one else." Just as Elena finally finds her true match, Alec and his lover set out to destroy them. Can Elena escape their trap, and will Stefano save her in time?

the-alpha-heir-gave-me-to-his-brother.text: "I'd rather you had let me bleed out." Those were my Alpha's last words after I spent a lifetime loving the man whose life I saved. Reborn, I ask for only one thing—freedom. Instead, he forces me to mate his younger brother. What he doesn't know is that his brother has spent three years searching for the mysterious girl who once saved him... and she's me. When the truth finally comes out, which brother will regret losing me first?

my-royal-rebound.text: Head over heels for Preston, the Principal's son, Mia has always put him first. But when she finds out he's been cheating on her with the rich heiress Vivian Walden, Mia hatches a grand escape plan with Preston's opportunistic mother. Will Preston capture her heart back before it leaves permanently for London, or will Sebastian, the mysterious royal boy from London get Mia's love?

the-alpha-and-beta-s-shared-mate.text: I’ve been dreading my eighteenth birthday for as long as I can remember. My mating day was even worse than I could have imagined. Not only was I mated to the Alpha and the Beta, they don’t want me. Publicly cast aside for another woman, I fled into the wilderness, entirely unaware that I was actually a forbidden wolf-vampire hybrid. To protect me from a corrupt Council, my family wiped my memories, leaving me stranded in a rogue town as "Katie"—heavily pregnant and completely lost. But my past violently caught up when my mates and their secret Alpha brother, Mason, tracked me down. With a dark conspiracy now targeting my newborn daughter to breed a lethal hybrid army, I must survive a volatile web of dangerous desires to protect my child before a brutal war consumes us all.

the-atlantic-bride.text: In The Atlantic Bride movie, in 1911, amid New York’s Gilded Age, Evelyn Hart, a rural English schoolteacher, voyages across the ocean for love, only to suffer betrayal at the hands of her fiancé Thomas. On the ocean liner, she comes to the rescue of Julian Kane, a mysterious wounded man, and agrees to a marriage of convenience with him when left with nowhere to turn. Little does she know he is the heir to the Kane family empire, commanding railways, shipping and steel. What begins as a reclusive tycoon hiding his true identity blossoms into a tender romance. As workplace clashes and taunts from her old rival mount, affection grows between them, while the truth of his identity slowly surfaces amid the unfolding drama.

summer-with-a-superstar.text: Straight-A bookworm Georgia Pruitt accidentally shoves rockstar Riot Cross off his stage, so her strict father ships her to Silver Pines reform camp, where Riot's label sends him too. Bound as accountability buddies, the enemies fall in love through bullying storms, lakeside rescues, a stolen kiss, and a rewritten love song. When leaked photos force a breakup, Riot leaps from his departing car to sing with her onstage, and they choose each other and music school over Harvard and the tour.

don-t-say-i-do.text: Ava Lin’s Manhattan wedding turns into a nightmare when a voice from three years in the future warns her not to marry Ryan Hall. Her groom has secretly registered a marriage with her best friend, Mia Chen, who is already pregnant with his child. In the original timeline, Ava was framed as unstable, stripped of her career and trust, and forced into psychiatric evaluation. This time, she refuses to break down for their cameras. Guided by her future self, Ava gathers marriage records, recordings, legal proof, and the hidden safeguards left by her parents. As Ryan, Mia, and the powerful Hall family try to silence her and seize control of her inheritance, Ava turns the fake wedding into a public reckoning, exposes their fraud, freezes the Hall Group’s IPO, and finally saves herself from the future that once destroyed her.

my-two-dangerous-roommates-crave-me.text: Eli got busted watching gay porn, and now the whole campus knows he's into guys. One of them is the guy he likes—but he's not the only one watching. The other roommate claims he hates him, yet he keeps falling deeper, step by step. Now both roommates are going feral over him—one with sweet traps, the other with raw possession. Eli's move? He keeps them both in his grip. The rule is simple: he picks no one. Want to stay? Play by his rules.

my-immortal-love.text: In My Immortal Love movie, after being fired and betrayed on her birthday, Lana’s life takes a supernatural turn when she becomes the first person in 2,000 years to see Augustus—a cursed, invisible Roman immortal. Believing Lana is his destined "miracle," Augustus begs her to help break his eternal curse. There's just one deadly catch: to set him free, she must kill him. As they grow closer and undeniable sparks fly, Lana is torn between her deepening love and the cruel fate demanding his sacrifice. Can they defeat the ancient gods and break the curse without losing each other, or is their romance doomed?

the-eight-year-old-captain.text: Ethan Cole, a top-tier aviation legend in his previous life, dies as a national aviation legend. He is reborn as an 8-year-old boy on the same flight where he once flew with his father. Only this time, he knows the truth: Flight 8236 is going to crash, and everyone on board will die. At 9,000 meters above sea level, fire begins to burn along the wings. The fuselage cracks open into freezing air. As panic spreads across the cabin, Ethan realizes he is the only one who understands what is coming. Trapped in a child’s body, he must stop the disaster and save his father—the man he loves most—before it is too late.

my-protective-mafia-lover.text: Serena Hale was a devoted wife. But her husband hadn't touched her in months. So when a stranger pulled her from a bar one night, she surrendered to him - because in her drugged haze, she thought he was her husband. One mistake. That stranger is Evan Knight - the billionaire underworld king now funding her husband's company. He knows she's married. He doesn't care. He's been waiting for her for sixteen years - since the rainy night she saved a beaten boy in an alley and didn't even remember his face. But he remembered everything. Her piano. Her voice. The way the rain clung to her white dress. Now he sits across from her at every dinner, watches her husband fake devotion, and whispers: "You don't belong to him." And the worst part? She's starting to agree. Even as she discovers that her husband murdered her parents. Even as she plans her revenge. There's only one man she trusts with the blade. But trusting him means betraying herself. And she's already fallen for him.

fake-husband-hidden-king.text: Lucas returns to LA as the mysterious CEO of Apex Group, ready to marry his beloved girlfriend, Evelyn. But Evelyn mistakes him for a nobody and leaves him for a "richer man." Little does she know, she just dumped the most powerful billionaire in LA. Then, a stunning female CEO enters Lucas’s life and she gets down on one knee and proposes to Lucas. CEO meets CEO. Together, they become the most powerful couple in the world and make every idiot who underestimated them regret it!

my-first-love-pays-to-watch-me-strip.text: Once a straight A freshman, Emma Lucas lost everything when Adrian Cole filmed her in bed and let her nudes spread across campus. He said her brother owed his sister a life, then made Emma pay for it. Three years later, Emma strips to keep Ryan alive, only to find Adrian in the VIP booth, paying men to humiliate her. “How did you get this cheap?” But when her family shatters and the truth about Lily resurfaces, Adrian’s revenge starts looking like the cruelest mistake of his life.

the-mafia-s-stolen-bride.text: Sabrina wakes from a crash to find her husband cheating with her best friend. To steal her $5 billion trust, he "gives" her to his Mafia uncle, Silas. She fakes amnesia and uses Silas's power to destroy them both—exposing fake pregnancy, stealing deals, sending her husband to prison. When she tries to leave, Silas corners her: "You took ten years to reach me. Now you want to run?" He waited in the shadows for a decade—and finally turns her from a bargaining chip into his bride.

tempted-by-my-bad-boy-stepbrother.text: Olivia has secretly loved her stepbrother Jacob for years — but ever since their parents' wedding, he's treated her like a stranger. He races motorcycles and lives on the edge; she's the golden girl who never breaks a rule. When one reckless night forces them together, buried feelings start clawing their way to the surface. Some lines were never meant to be crossed.

dirty-work.text: A modern romantic psychological thriller in the tone of Fifty Shades of Grey and Secretary, Assistant is dark, seductive, outrageously thought-provoking, and riveting. Directorial debut of genre filmmaker Louisa Warren (Cannibal Cabin, Hard Copy).

the-prank-that-broke-us.text: High school star student Eleanor Vance has been best friends with Leo Carter for 16 years, until he knocks her out and ties her to a goalpost as a “prank” to impress the popular girl Savannah. Humiliated in front of the whole school, Ellie transfers to California without a word. There, she finds real friends, academic success, and a caring new boyfriend. Meanwhile, Leo loses his mind with regret, but Ellie has learned that some betrayals can never be forgiven.

the-godfather-s-guardian-angel.text: On a snowy Thanksgiving, young healer Rita lives with her ungrateful uncle William and his cruel family. They exploit her powers, sabotage her feast, and secretly hire a thug to drive her away. Hunted and alone, she is rescued by mafia godfather Richard Genovese and his wife. Discovering their kindness and lack of an heir, they adopt her. On the journey, Rita's powers save them from crises, alarming Richard's rival. At the manor, she heals Richard's dying father, Arthur, and finds a lost heirloom. Her courage and abilities win the family's trust. Rita becomes a true Genovese, protecting her new family with everything she has.

i-chose-the-playboy-eel-to-abandon-my-sh.text: I’m Seraphina, ocean princess. In my last life, I loved shark lord Kael, yet he held me down while his lover Lira stabbed my heart with venom crystal. Reborn on my mate-picking day, I shocked everyone by choosing Rhys, the playful dragon eel playboy. Kael seethed, ignored me when assassins poisoned me, and knelt begging me to ditch Rhys later. But Lira’s fake fragility hides deadly malice—she just pushed me into deadly undertow. Can Rhys reach me before I drown?

king-of-gold.text: In 1849, the American West, poor dockworker William is betrayed by his lover and his boss, losing everything and becoming a slave laborer in a gold mine. On the brink of death, he awakens a mysterious "Golden Eye" that allows him to see through anything and uncover hidden treasures. From a powerless nobody to a legendary mining tycoon, William uses his extraordinary vision and intelligence to defeat the elites who once crushed him!

the-god-of-tides.text: Rejected by his royal family and cast into the ocean as a child, Kai secretly becomes the legendary God of Tides. Years later, he returns home in disguise to find the pirate kingdom under siege. Now, Kai must save his family, all the while dealing with a father who thinks that he's worthless.

chained-by-hades-the-underworld-king.text: Elena, the daughter of the Lord of Yalkreon, ventures out in search of sacred tree sap to save her mother from a deadly ice curse. Along the way, she unexpectedly rescues Hades, King of the Underworld, who immediately decides to make her his queen. But Elena is betrayed by her fiancé, then forcibly sold as a sacrifice to the Lord of the Frostlands by her cruel stepmother and greedy father. Just as all hope is lost during the sacrificial ceremony, Hades descends in overwhelming force, punishes everyone who has wronged her, and takes her back to the Underworld under his protection.

caught-the-ruthless-alpha-s-runaway-luna.text: Betrayed by her boyfriend. Hunted down by her father. Forced to mate with a ruthless Alpha King. Cora thought her life was over until she escaped and accidentally marked a dangerous, magnetic stranger. Left with no choice, she accepted a fake mating proposal from that stranger, totally unaware that her "contract mate" is the very Alpha King she’s desperately trying to escape...

fate-of-the-dragon-s-bride.text: Medieval times. Dragons rule the continent. Lydia is forced by her family to marry the "savage" Dragon King, Lucian, in her sister's place. She flees into the night — and in a blizzard-buried cabin, she encounters a dragon-shifter whose power is spiraling out of control. To save him, she gives him her virginity... The next day, she is captured. Her secret dragon pregnancy is exposed, and she is branded an unclean sinner, dragged onto the trial platform. Meanwhile, Lucian searches for her frantically, tearing a scale from his own heart to cast a tracking spell. When the crystal ball reveals the truth — that Lydia is the woman who saved him, unintentionally carrying his heir — and with Lydia's life hanging by a thread, he descends from the sky to pull her into his arms and declare to all: she is his only bride.

the-road-not-taken.text: This is a female-oriented revenge short drama with a rebirth & counterattack theme. With her past-life memories, the heroine Chloe is reborn. She avoids the marriage-robbing trap set by her sister Lily, gives up the false shortcut of becoming a mafia godmother, and chooses to accept the upright wealthy businessman Jayce who is in financial crisis. Relying on her experience in managing underground industries from her previous life, she helps Jayce turn the tables and reach the top. In the end, the evildoers get what they deserve, and Chloe becomes the ultimate ruler of both the legal and underworld worlds on the East Coast.

i-married-my-cheating-ex-s-uncle.text: Wealthy heiress Vivian Sterling publicly breaks her engagement after catching fiancé Bryce with her stepsister. Having secretly recovered from paralysis months ago, she stands from her wheelchair to reclaim her power. That night, she meets Adrian, a dangerous, motorcycle-riding mechanic who saves her from harassment. After a one-night stand, she proposes a contract marriage to escape Bryce's stalking. Vivian believes Adrian is merely a handsome working-class man, unaware he is the true heir to the Hale dynasty—and Bryce's most feared uncle. A decade earlier, Adrian was the one who pulled her from a fatal car crash and bore the scars; Bryce stole the credit and her ten years of devotion. As Vivian falls for Adrian, Bryce and his father Gerald launch a campaign of kidnapping, media manipulation, corporate traps, and assassination. When Adrian is rushed into the ER covered in blood, Vivian finally discovers the man she married for revenge is her real rescuer and only true love. What began as a contract marriage escalates into a high-stakes war for love, fortune, and survival.

100-day-contract-mafia-s-dangerous-desir.text: To save her daughter, Harper Reed marries Klaus Wolfe—New York's most feared mafia godfather—in her stepsister's place. On the wedding day, he sees right through her and calls her a gold digger. He gives her one choice: jump into a shark pool, or watch her whole family die. Then she jumps without hesitation. That shatters his frozen heart. But she finds out that—this marriage is way worse than death. Lydia deeply hates her. Uncle Richard wants the Don's chair. And "Black Fox" is dragging everyone to hell...

rent-a-mom-for-the-billionaire-twins.text: Ruby only meant to take a temporary nanny job for quick money, but she accidentally walks into the frozen world of billionaire Ethan Cole and his impossible twins. The children have already driven away sixteen nannies, Ethan runs his home like a boardroom, and every corner of the estate is ruled by cold order instead of warmth. What begins as a one-week trial quickly turns into something much larger. As Ruby challenges the household’s rigid rules, the twins slowly begin to trust again, Ethan is forced to confront the way he confuses control with parenting, and an external power struggle over custody, inheritance, and corporate leadership starts closing in. Caught between family politics and emotional chaos, Ruby becomes the first person who can truly reach the children—and the first one capable of changing Ethan himself. What started as a hired role becomes something real: she was brought in to play a mother, but she ends up becoming the heart of the family.

sister-stole-my-mate-i-got-the-dragon-ki.text: At their mate-selection ceremony, Grant rejects Mara in front of both tribes and gives her place to her crying younger sister. He swears it is only temporary. He has forgotten one thing: Mara turns twenty-two in three days. Under tribal law, an unmated woman loses her right to choose, and Mara has already been assigned to the dying Dragon King. Grant expects her father to stop it. Mara accepts the decree. Three days later, as Grant comes to bond with Brenna, one hundred dragon guards arrive at the Hale gates to escort Mara away as their future queen.

a-mother-s-vengeance.text: In my past life, my husband's niece drowned my newborn. To protect their precious heiress, the mafia family told me to let it go. When I refused, my own husband murdered me. Now, I’ve been reborn on the morning it all happened. This time, I secretly send my son to my father, the most powerful Mafia Godfather in the city. But when I return to the party, another baby still ends up in the pool. Predictably, my husband and his family rush to destroy the body to cover it up. Now there's just one question: whose child did their golden girl really kill?

the-alpha-king-sold-me-to-the-war-god.text: Sold at auction and cast aside by the Alpha who bought her, Omega Elena is handed off to his vanished uncle—the Lycan King and War God, Finn—only to discover that her five children were his all along, and that the man she thought had betrayed her has loved and protected her from the very start.

my-marriage-with-the-god-of-death.text: When Naomi accidentally summons Thanatos, the God of Death, a desperate kiss awakens his heart after ten thousand years. Revealed as his destined Bride of Death, Naomi is the only one who can break his curse, while the immortal reaper discovers that even a god can fall in love.

the-virgin-sacrifice-the-dragon-king-cla.text: Princess Valerie marries the ruthless Dragon King Therak to save her kingdom. But their wedding night hides a deadly game. Beneath her pillow lies the dagger meant for his heart. In his veins flows a curse: devour her before the Blood Moon, or die. Yet when danger strikes, Therak risks his life to protect her. Enemies by fate, lovers by choice. The Blood Moon rises. One must die.

a-hundred-years-of-you.text: A witch cursed Prince Alexander to sleep for a century. Only a Jones daughter's kiss can break it. Catherine, once bound to Prince Arthur who chose her half-sister, enters Vandros Castle and awakens Alexander through a three-night ritual. His soul had escaped as a bat, guarding her since childhood. They fall in love. Arthur storms their wedding, but Catherine rejects him. Two princes duel on a cliff. She chooses Alexander. Arthur falls to a fiery end. They wed, sealed by blood and heart.

my-sex-robot-has-my-enemy-s-face.text: Reese Calder orders a custom companion android, 006, with the face of Nolan Vance, her spoiled, maddening lifelong rival. By day, 006 cooks, cleans, and kneels when she says, "Down." By night, he breaks every command and makes her forget he is supposed to be a machine. Then Kindred Care texts: "Your companion hasn't shipped yet." Nolan calls it a prank. Miles calls it suicide: "If Reese finds the truth, you're done." But Reese finds the truth anyway, and now the liar is still kneeling.

the-wolfless-alpha-queen.text: Thirteen years ago, a traitorous scheme tore the Bloodwolf Clan apart. The true-born princess, still just a child, was cast out in the wild, losing all memory of who she really was. At nineteen, she awakens the overpowering Progenitor's Power. Returning home, she finds her Mother tortured, her father paralyzed, and the traitors colluding with the enemy to destroy the clan from the inside. Will the true-born princess be able to reclaim her throne and save her people?

the-alpha-king-s-half-blood-twins.text: Annie, a human, fell in love with Fenrir, the wolf king, and bore twin half-blood children. Yet they were brutally exiled due to blood prejudice and Mara’s malicious schemes. Five years later, the twins’ werewolf blood awakens unexpectedly, dragging the whole family back into power struggles and deadly hunts. Following the clues, Fenrir uncovers the truth of the past. While protecting his wife and daughters, he exacts revenge on the real mastermind behind all the crimes.

the-rabbit-bride-who-rejected-her-alpha-.text: I‘m Elowen, the only rabbit shifter with purifying blood, destined to be Alpha King Kael’s Luna. But on our bonding altar, he brought his pregnant snake mistress, ordering me to raise their child as their servant. I revoked our bond and offered myself to any shifter willing to claim me. Everyone feared Kael—until cursed, discarded Prince Rowan stepped forward. I chose him, my pure blood suppressing his deadly curse. The old prophecy shifted to us. Kael lost all power and begged me back, while his serpent lover sank into dark corruption. Can Rowan and I stop the feral beast tide sweeping the realm?

betrayed-then-birthed-titans.text: At her engagement ceremony, Evadne is slapped, shamed, and rejected by Valerius, the Black Dragon prince, after her scheming twin sister steals the sacred power meant to protect her future. Branded impure before the entire realm, Evadne makes one impossible choice: she marries Aurelius, the cursed god-king everyone fears. But her sister’s stolen power hides a cruel secret—every shameful child she conceives can be forced into Evadne’s body. What they don’t know is Evadne’s own gift can purify any bloodline and awaken extinct Titans. The more they try to ruin her, the more divine monsters she gives birth to.

my-hot-firefighter-ex.text: I called 911 because I accidentally handcuffed myself to my bed. I expected a locksmith. Instead, my ex-boyfriend kicked down my door—with three firefighters behind him. He thinks another man tied me up and abandoned me. Then I blurt out, "No, I didn't use protection." Now he's furious, jealous, and refusing to believe the truth. My biggest embarrassment just became his biggest misunderstanding... and neither of us is ready for what comes next.

late-bloomer.text: The tycoon, in order to be with his lover, asked his handsome and strong driver to seduce his wife, thereby causing her to have an affair, with the aim of having her leave the house with nothing. In the end, the boss’s plan was exposed, and both he and his lover faced punishment. The driver also realized the importance of being down-to-earth and returned to the countryside.

you-can-t-stop-my-super-x-ray-vision.text: After his girlfriend dumps him, Michael, a luxury brand CEO with X-ray vision, uses his powers and confidence to bring down arrogant global influencer bullies, all while winning the heart of his high school's most popular girl.

forced-to-marry-my-ruined-ex-the-duke-s-.text: When the Duke dies suddenly, his greedy brother Richard steals the title and fortune. Overnight, Cordelia—the Duke’s only daughter—is stripped of her nobility and secretly blinded in a vicious plot. To protect her commoner lover, Luke, she brutally breaks his heart and drives him away. Believing she abandoned him for status, Luke leaves for the frontier, fueled by hatred. Years later, Luke returns as Luciano Thorne, the Empire's most powerful war hero and new Duke. Meanwhile, Cordelia is trapped at home, desperately guarding what's left of her inheritance. When her uncle forces the blind Cordelia to marry a 70-year-old merchant, Luciano arrives with an immense dowry to claim her himself. Luciano intends to punish her for the "betrayal." But seeing her scars and suffering, his hatred turns back into obsession. As they get caught up in revenge and irresistible attraction, the truth finally comes to light. Ultimately, the feared war god bows only to her, restoring her sight and placing the ducal crown back on the woman he has always worshiped.

secretly-pregnant-with-the-billionaire-s.text: Six years ago, college student Isabel was framed, leading to an unexpected encounter with billionaire heir Ethan, after which she became pregnant and dropped out of school. Six years later, Isabel works tirelessly to raise her child, who suffers from severe allergies. By a twist of fate, she joins Ethan's company and becomes his personal assistant. Faced with relentless bullying and even life-threatening schemes against her child by the vicious heiress Rachel, Isabel refuses to back down and bravely fights back. As they spend time together day and night, Ethan not only repeatedly steps in to save her but also falls deeply in love with her. As the plot unfolds, the child's true bloodline identity is unexpectedly revealed to Ethan's family, specifically his great-grandmother, Olivia. In the end, the malicious Rachel faces the consequences of her actions and is handed over to the police. Isabel unexpectedly becomes pregnant with twins—a boy and a girl—and shares a grand, perfectly happy ending with Ethan.

pregnant-with-the-dragon-lord-s-last-hei.text: Laila, a destitute widow, is forced off a cliff by the tyrannical Governor Barrow—only to fall into the sacred dragon realm. There, she spends one fateful night with King Kael, a dragon sovereign bound by a deadly curse that burns any woman he touches. Ten months later, she gives birth to a royal dragon egg. Hunted by Barrow, she desperately entrusts the egg to the dragon clan. When the temple issues a decree seeking one who can hatch the egg, Laila tears down the royal notice and steps forward. Despite scorn and humiliation from the nobles, she reunites with Kael. In the end, it is her unconditional mother's love that awakens the dying egg—and a penniless commoner becomes the mother of the dragon clan's sole heir.

she-bows-for-no-one.text: Isabella gave up her secret life as the leader of the legendary Shadow Circle to be with her beloved mate, whom she works hard as an herbalist to support. But when he's promoted to Alpha's General, instead of thanking her, he breaks their mate bond and replaces her with a scheming Commander's Daughter. He's not expecting the Alpha himself to show up and reveal Isabella is the lost wolf princess — destined to be Alpha Queen — and he'll regret letting her go.

puck-perfect-my-sex-education-tutor.text: Olivia, an art student harboring a secret crush on a star hockey player, accidentally stumbles upon the shocking truth: Liam, the campus playboy, is secretly an anonymous adult content creator. To keep his secret safe, the two enter into a dangerous "fake dating" pact. As they navigate endless teasing, power struggles, and joint battles against campus bullying and malicious schemes, their pretend romance begins to blur into real passion. However, just as they finally face their true feelings for each other, a deadly blackmail scheme threatens to destroy everything Liam holds dear...

pregnant-by-his-alpha-brother.text: Sloane was a fake mate assigned to heir Royce. For three years, he never marked her, spiked her drinks with suppressants, and humiliated her in public. His brother Kael, whose Thorne blood Sloane recognized at a ceremony, returned and proposed a deal: “Three months, he never pleased you once. I need one night.” One true bite shattered the fake bond. Sloane carried Kael's pup. Royce killed Magnus for the seat, kidnapped seven-months-pregnant Sloane, and confessed to everything—recorded live by the ring she wore. Royce was caged for life. Kael knelt before the pack and asked Sloane to be his Luna.

from-puppet-bride-to-alpha-queen.text: Ever since my Omega sister saved me from wolfsbane poisoning, she used that life debt to control every detail of my existence—including my wedding. She picked the flowers, designed the theme, and even tried on wedding dresses with my groom while he smiled in delight. Every time I voiced my outrage, they weaponized the past to silence me: "She saved your life! Why are you always acting like the villain?" If they want the wedding so badly, they can keep each other. I discarded my ring and returned to my royal pack, took my throne as Alpha Queen.

the-glass-cage.text: On the night before her engagement, Celeste Yarrow is locked inside a rooftop glass greenhouse by Ingrid Sloane, drenched in freezing water while the guests film and laugh. Damien Thorne, the man she spent three years saving, refuses to protect her and even exposes her deepest trauma for Ingrid’s amusement. Everyone thinks Celeste is just a small-town woman clinging to power, but she is the real force behind Yarrow Capital and the projects that made Thorne rise. After shattering the glass cage herself, Celeste cancels the engagement, pulls her investment, releases the evidence, and makes every betrayer pay.

his-caged-love.text: Bankrupt heiress Isolde signs a three-year mistress contract with Savien Thorne, heir to the Thorn Group, just to cover her mother’s life-saving medical bills. The second the contract ends, she’s ready to walk away for good. Until she finds out she’s pregnant. His arranged fiancée learns the secret, and torments her at every turn. Worse — she’s never been anything but a double for the other woman. She moves out and cuts all ties. But he’s not letting her get away.

crowned-in-his-claws.text: Exiled half-beast prince Cassian storms back from the dead, slaughters his father, and seizes the throne in a bloodbath. His first prey, Vera, the ice-cold former queen. The woman who crushed their love for a crown, married his father, and cast him into the beast pit to rot. Consumed by rage, the ruthless new king forces his stepmother into his bed as his personal captive and swears to kill Lucian, Vera's royal son with the dead king. Then a bombshell drops. His so-called half-brother shares his rare, exclusive beast blood. Vera has hidden the truth of Lucian's identity.

the-raven-wolf-king-wolfless.text: “Did you get rejected?!” My sister Jade laughs at me. “I knew it! I told you that you would. No one would ever want you. A wolfless. But I’m more surprised that you, of all people, found a fated mate. Kind of unfair if you ask me.” It stings to hear this. It’s exactly what happened. She was right. “Well, let’s not let this bring us down.” Mother smiles and claps. “It’s been decided that Jade is to be mated to the fourth wolf prince. ” Jade smirks. “One of the bastard illegitimate princes, but I’m not complaining.” She smiles with pride. “He’s still a prince.” The crowd suddenly grow noisy. The princes arrive. “Alpha Prince Dorian, the fourth prince, Antonio the fifth, and Emmet the sixth—all of them illegitimate.” All three men wave with broad smiles. Suddenly, another man hurries past them. “That’s Alpha Prince Raphael! Second born to a true royal‑blooded Luna.” The stunning blond man—his hair lighter than even my mother’s or sister’s—strides forward with an imposing pace. His bright blue eyes gleam beneath the black suit and satin shirt, half‑unbuttoned to reveal the edge of his tattoos. I freeze as his gaze locks onto mine. Time itself seems to stop, because that man… is him. The one who broke my heart. The one who rejected me. The one who shattered our bond. My fated mate.

locked-by-the-mafia-boss.text: My cold, ruthless Mafia godfather guardian tore off his mask the night of my twenty-first birthday. He doesn't want me to call him uncle anymore. He wants me as his caged bird.

the-mermaid-queen-s-revenge.text: Serlanty, East Sea mermaid princess, was drained of golden scales by her family and lover. The bastard Winsil stole her credit. She traded the Heart of the Ocean for human form, defeated evil with the Land King and found true love.

bound-to-the-ruthless-beast.text: Beast King Elden bears a lethal lightning curse—any living thing he touches burns to cinders. Human girl Vera is the only one who can endure his touch. To break the curse, he forces her into marriage by holding her mother hostage. Vera resents him, but glimpses his sincere heart: he heals her, shields her, and crumbles when she prays for him barefoot through brambles. The curse can be broken by consummation—but Vera would die from the backlash. Elden makes an antidote, but the villainess Lia swaps it for poison. On their wedding night, the curse lifts—but Vera collapses, never to wake. Elden mourns her for six years at her grave. But Vera is alive, raising twin children with golden beast ears in the human slums. One snowy day, her daughter clings to a passing man's leg—"Daddy." Elden finds his lost family. But Vera cannot forgive his deception, and an old enemy's father has raised a poison bow, vowing blood revenge.

after-the-sacred-whale-betrayed-me-i-con.text: A gifted contract mage, Layla, spent her past life collecting ninety-nine sacred cores to help her contracted beast, the Sacred Whale Neil, take human form—only to have Neil pierce her heart and push her into the Bloodtide Trench the moment he transformed. Reborn on the day of the contract ceremony, Layla abandons the Sacred Whale and chooses a dying little spirit snake instead. Neil, now in human form, teams up with her sister Evelyn to humiliate her, but the little snake turns out to be Poseidon, the Sea Emperor. As past betrayals and old wounds resurface, Neil kneels in regret—too late. Only Poseidon stands by her side. This time, Layla will never waste herself on the unworthy again, and finally learns to live for herself.

my-safe-word-was-revenge.text: Caleb Shaw calls BDSM a cure for his dead marriage, then chains his wife Mara to a tree for his mistress. When Mara says the safe word, he leaves with the key. By sunrise, Nina’s hired men find her. But Caleb never knew what Mara buried for this marriage. She was not just his wife. She was the woman who once owned the West Side docks. Now the collar, the blood, and the betrayal will drag every Shaw secret into the light.

make-my-cheating-husband-pay-the-price.text: Catherine, pregnant and controller of FG Group, catches her husband Jesse cheating on video with mistress Mia. She brings his disabled father Walter to the billiard parlor, where Mia shatters Catherine's family crest necklace, smokes illegally, and brutally assaults both the pregnant Catherine and elderly Walter—almost killing the unborn child. When Jesse arrives, he takes Mia's side—until he learns Walter is his biological father and Mia has committed grievous bodily harm. Business tycoon John Morgan, who had cut ties with Jesse, watches Catherine's abuse live. He arrives, reveals his true identity, and shatters Jesse's business hopes. Jesse and Mia slander Catherine, but she files suit with full evidence of assault, adultery, and illegal fund diversion. They are arrested and imprisoned. A year later, Catherine makes the Forbes list. John Morgan proposes publicly. Catherine lets go of the past and begins a new life.

uncle-i-don-t-want-you-anymore.text: Ava once saved Ethan after he was drugged, only to be forced into a marriage that made him hate her until her death. Reborn on the same night, she refuses to be his antidote, cuts him out of her life, protects her grandfather, and exposes Chloe's lies. This life is not about making Ethan regret her; it is about walking toward someone who truly catches her.

revenge-of-the-black-swan.text: Wendy, a naturally gifted ballet prodigy, had her identity maliciously swapped at birth by Helena, a former dancer consumed by jealousy. For eighteen years, she endured abuse and suppression, yet quietly clung to her dream of dancing. To cover her grandfather’s medicalsurgery expenses, she took a job at a theatre and signed up for a competition. However, Angela, the impostor heiress, repeatedly framed her. Worse still, her birth mother Sophia wrongfully accused her of plagiarism, getting her blacklisted across the industry.In her darkest hour, Alexander, a corporate CEO, recognized her talent and resilience. He funded her grandfather’s surgery and supported her as she competed in the International Dance Invitational. Wendy triumphed with her outstanding skill and staged a remarkable comeback. As the truth about her birth unfolded, Angela resorted to desperate measures and orchestrated a car crash, only for all her crimes to come to light. In the end, Wendy reunites with her birth mother, rises to the pinnacle of international ballet, and finds sincere loveachieving a double triumph in both her career and life.

outgrowing-my-old-magic-love.text: I dated Lucien secretly for three years, but he denied me at graduation after a heartbeat test paired him with his rival Seraphina. He even stole my umbrella and altered my overseas academy admission. I cut all contact and flew to Arcadia to rebuild myself. Years later, he traveled thousands of miles to beg for a second chance. Yet I met Nathan, a sincere mage who treats me as an equal. Will I ever forgive the boy who broke me completely?
