private-lessons-with-my-vampire-boss.text: After years of being dismissed by her husband, Eric, as uptight, boring, and hopelessly inexperienced, Chloe finally decides she’s had enough. Desperate to save her dying marriage—and prove she can be the woman he wants—she ventures into an exclusive underground club for a private lesson in pleasure. But Chloe walks into the wrong room. What she mistakes for an elite adults-only training session is actually a secret gathering where vampires select their human blood thralls. And the man she approaches for guidance is no ordinary instructor. Victor is a ruthless billionaire, a predator hiding at the very top of human society—and a powerful vampire Dom accustomed to complete obedience. Unaware of what he truly is, Chloe asks him to teach her how to submit. One forbidden night leaves Victor craving far more than her blood. Using her desire to save her marriage as bait, he offers her a dangerous arrangement: become his sub, obey his every command, and serve as his exclusive blood thrall……

he-paid-for-one-night-then-wanted-foreve.text: Klare is an overlooked nurse at Venus Hospital, struggling with severe anxiety after a family tragedy. Her only comfort is submitting online to a mysterious “Master,” whose commands make her feel safe. But in real life, her new boss, Dance Gordon, is arrogant, sharp-tongued, and always targeting her. By day, they clash at the hospital. By night, he is the perfect Master behind the screen, giving all his patience and tenderness to his one and only — “Cake.” Enemies in real life. Addicted online.

romance-lessons-with-my-quarterback.text: Leo has always been one rank behind Jaxon, the star quarterback who takes everything Leo wants, including his crush, the hottest girl on campus. What Leo doesn't know is that Jaxon is secretly in love with him. So Jaxon tanks an exam on purpose, then makes Leo an offer — Tutor me to keep my captaincy, and I'll teach you how to win your dream girl. Studying calculus by day, dating lessons by night — and one plan Leo never accounted for, falling for his romance coach, his biggest rival.

wrong-heir-right-her.text: Six years ago, top lawyer Madeline met wealthy heir Nicholas at a masquerade ball and later gave birth to a clever daughter Isla. Her half-sister Vivienne stole keepsakes to pretend to be Nicholas's lover, coveting wealth and status. Later, Madeline worked at Nicholas's group and reunited with him. Romance bloomed between them amid constant workplace schemes and threats. Clues including a rare hereditary disease and identical birthmarks revealed the truth. Eventually, Vivienne's fraud was exposed. All misunderstandings were cleared up. Madeline and Nicholas chose each other, and the three lived a happy life together.

two-mafia-bosses-begging-me-for-love.text: I ran from my arranged wedding after catching my fiancé in bed with another woman. That same night, I lost my virginity to a stranger—only to discover he was my fiancé all along. When I became pregnant, he looked me in the eye and said, “Get rid of the baby.” I walked away for good... until his powerful rival offered me a new life. Now two mafia heirs are fighting for me, but only one deserves my heart. The problem? The man who broke me refuses to let me go.

the-don-s-bloody-bride.text: After Dante Conti let his mistress Selena Russo torment their six-year-old daughter Sofia, Isabella Moretti fought back and was locked inside Ashford Sanitarium. Years later, Dante forced her to sign away her rights with Sofia’s urn as a threat, believing he had broken her forever. But Sicily turned the abandoned wife into Don Moretti. Backed by Luca Ricci, the Don of Palermo, and the hidden power of her father Vittorio, Isabella returns to New York’s Five Families banquet to expose Selena’s lies, reclaim her empire, and make Dante watch the Conti throne collapse for every drop of blood he spilled.

my-boss-is-my-secret-online-dom.text: Klare is an overlooked nurse at Venus Hospital, struggling with severe anxiety after a family tragedy. Her only comfort is submitting online to a mysterious “Master,” whose commands make her feel safe. But in real life, her new boss, Dance Gordon, is arrogant, sharp-tongued, and always targeting her. By day, they clash at the hospital. By night, he is the perfect Master behind the screen, giving all his patience and tenderness to his one and only — “Cake.” Enemies in real life. Addicted online.

i-gave-my-flame-up.text: Three years after leaving Onyx Stormfire, Serafina meets him again at the Grand Clan Gathering hosted by the Ravenwing clan—only to find another woman at his side. No one knows that Serafina once gave up half of her own dragonfire to save Onyx from death, then pretended she had fallen for his younger brother, Corin, so Onyx would hate her and stop searching for the truth. The divided flame has left her unable to shift, and the last of her dragonfire is fading. She has returned only to see him one final time. When Corin reveals the truth, Onyx risks everything to reach her. Their twin dragonfires finally reunite, saving them both. Locke is exposed as the poisoner behind the conspiracy, while Vessa’s false pregnancy scheme falls apart. At last, Serafina and Onyx become bonded mates, vowing to grow old together.

a-spicy-text-to-my-nemesis.text: Evelyn, an ordinary high school student, is publicly humiliated after her crush on a popular hockey player is exposed. Devastated, she musters up the courage to send him nudes anonymously in hopes of catching his eye. But she accidentally sends the pics to Colton instead, the captain of the hockey team who always teases her. What will happen between them?

the-encore-of-us.text: To protect her beloved boyfriend Noah, Amelia accidentally causes her father’s “death.” In order to safeguard their shared dream of a musical future, she hides her pregnancy, pretends to cheat, breaks up with Noah, and turns herself in—serving seven years in prison. Upon release, Amelia discovers their daughter Lisa has leukemia, and only umbilical cord blood can save her. With no other choice, she approaches Noah-now a global music star, and reconnects with him physically, hiding the truth behind her return. Noah has never stopped loving her, but the heartbreak of Amelia‘s sudden betrayal still lingers. As they’re drawn back into each other’s orbit, love and pain collide. Just when the truth begins to surface, her “dead” father suddenly reappears...

the-dragon-s-return-reclaiming-my-throne.text: On the Dragon Continent, bloodline is everything. Pure dragon blood grants shifting forms and magic resistance. Those who can't shift are called Exiles — treated as slaves. Kaelen, firstborn of the Red Dragon House, was born unable to shift. On the eve of his coming-of-age, his three brothers cut his tendons, stripped his inheritance, and took his fiancée. His father branded him a slave and exiled him to the Silent Deadfire Volcano. In the volcano's depths, disaster became blessing. The dragon blood within him awakened the ancient Progenitor Dragon God's inheritance. Over ten years, his severed bones regenerated, and he mastered world-destroying Dragon Tongue magic. Ten years later, holy war breaks out. The Red Dragon House faces extinction. Kaelen returns as a cold dragon hunter—identity hidden. One crisis after another forces his enemies to kneel. His former fiancée regrets everything. In the end, before the entire continent, he reveals his true form: the Progenitor Dragon, reclaiming his throne.

the-alpha-commander-s-long-awaited-omega.text: “It’s just a formality.” Reynolds threw those words in Eliot’s face on their wedding day, leaving him behind to greet his comrade. Four years of lies, another Alpha’s scent on Reynolds’ skin.Eliot didn’t cry. He ripped off his ring, threw it at Reynolds’ feet, and walked into the hall across.Vaughn had been waiting there for four years. White roses. Starlight lamps. A ring he’d kept since they were kids. He spent four years climbing four ranks just to rewrite the law that locked Omegas out of the mech bay. He never told Eliot. He just pried the door open and waited.

the-wingless-god.text: Cassia, the Wingless Goddess, was born a scapegoat for fake‑princess Celine. Mis‑prophesied as a doomsday omen at birth, she was abandoned by her birth father. Raised under the protection of her adoptive father, she awakens the legendary divine wings. She exposes that fake‑princess Celine is the real destroyer behind everything. Finally, she overthrows the corrupt Wing‑Caste system and ascends the throne as the new queen.

cursed-alpha-s-fated-luna.text: He's the strongest Alpha alive—cursed so that anyone who touches him burns to ash. She's a wolfless mage apprentice who fell from the sky straight into his arms… and didn't burn. Desperate to find her fated mate, Aria takes a job as Kael's personal maid, unaware the cold, dangerous Alpha is already falling for her. But a dark prophecy looms: their child will carry a curse far deadlier than his—and bearing it could cost Aria her life. When rivals attack and Aria's life hangs by a thread, Kael will face the deadliest mountain in the world to save her. Because some fates aren't written—they're fought for.

paper-marriage.text: For five years of marriage, I gave up my career and left everything behind to follow my brigadier general husband—only to end up living as an illegal resident on the base. He gave my military dependent slot to the girl we sponsored, and even had the lock on our home changed for her. Heartbroken, I left in the dead of night and started over in a new city. Seven years later, at a military arts festival, we crossed paths again. He was full of regret, but I was already standing next to another man. This time, I didn't look back.

the-wolves-regret-for-their-rabbit.text: Freya, a female rabbit beastkin, was adopted by Lady Hughes, her mother’s best friend, after her parents passed away. She grew up and attended school alongside Landon and Marcel, the twin wolf beastkin brothers of the Hughes household. The twins were popular celebrities at the beastkin academy. Leveraging her rabbit-type healing powers, Freya tirelessly helped them resolve all kinds of troubles, fully believing she would marry one of the two brothers someday. Everything fell apart the moment Charlotte, a fox beastkin, appeared. Charlotte schemed relentlessly to frame Freya and drive her away. She successfully manipulated the wolf twins into misunderstanding Freya, creating a rift between them. Tormented and wronged, Freya drifted apart from the brothers. Overcome with despair, she resolved to transfer schools and wed Grayson, the young heir of a lion beastkin clan. Only after Freya left did the Hughes twins wake up to the truth, see Charlotte the fox beastkin’s true colors clearly, and drown in remorse. Yet it was far too late. Freya was already with Grayson, had completely let go of the past, and was preparing for their wedding.

our-love-built-on-lies.text: Forced to spy on heir Lucien to pay her father’s debts, Elara finds herself trapped in a web of betrayal, lost love, and tragic loss. After the truth of her noble lineage surfaces, she must face a vindictive rival and a complicated past. Amidst power struggles and life-threatening danger, can Lucien’s ultimate sacrifice heal their broken bond?

positively-pregnant.text: Senior year was supposed to be the best year ever. Then two pink lines changed everything. Now Kelsey has to tell the campus heartthrob he's going to be a dad — and hide it all from the Dean who also happens to be her grandmother.

ceo-s-irresistible-wet-nurse.text: Tammy is a single mom who needs money to look for her son. Desperate for work, Tammy takes a a wet nurse job in a powerful manor, never guessing the cold, intimidating master is the father of her son. Nor that her touch alone breaks his years-long trauma with women. What he doesn't know is that he's about to hire her.

faked-my-death-destroyed-the-billionaire.text: She faked her death. Three years later, Sierra comes back to her own funeral with a new identity. She takes down her unfaithful ex and her best friend who betrayed her. She vows to take her three-year-old son back. For revenge, she teams up with Julian, the heir to the most powerful family. In a game of power, they go from sworn enemies to each other's only hope. Finally the truth comes out. They take everything back and find their way back to each other.

mommy-s-little-savior.text: Five years ago, Elena Hartwell broke up with her college boyfriend Killian Thorne to protect him from her ruthless uncle Victor—making him believe she was a gold-digger. Heartbroken, Killian returned to his family's trillion-dollar empire, while Elena was framed by Victor and imprisoned, where she gave birth to their daughter Luna. Now, brave 4-year-old Luna tracks down Killian at his corporate headquarters, shocking everyone by calling him "Daddy." After a DNA test confirms the truth, Killian learns of Elena's wrongful conviction and the sacrifices she made. With his power and resources, he sets out to free Elena, protect Luna from Victor's schemes, and win back the woman he never stopped loving.

salt-kiss.text: Based on the novel by Sierra Simone. Ex-soldier Tristan becomes bodyguard to his uncle-in-law, a magnetic billionaire who runs an exclusive sex club. Despite his best efforts to stay professional, Tristan's drawn to his boss’s dominance, breaking down his defenses until he finally submits. Under Mark’s seduction, Tristan is pulled into a world of pain and pleasure he never imagined. But his lust for Mark unravels when he’s sent to retrieve Mark’s fiancée… and falls for her too.

below-the-red-line.text: GT endurance driver Kai Mercer is pushed into a reserve role after refusing his sponsor’s sexual advances, while struggling with his father’s debts and his mother’s illness. Through an anonymous platform, Kai develops an intimate relationship with a mysterious man named Nox, unaware that Nox is actually Adrian Cross, his new team owner and a four-time World Endurance Champion. As Kai falls for both identities, Adrian’s secret creates a dangerous conflict of trust and power. When the truth is exposed, Kai walks away. After kidnappings, threats, professional investigations, and an ethics hearing, the two eventually rebuild their relationship, while Kai earns his place as a professional works driver.

the-stone-cursed-king-s-blood-bride.text: The human girl Lena is sacrificed to Draven, a Vampire King afflicted by a petrification curse, and the two unexpectedly forge a life-binding blood pact. To save Draven—who is left dying and drained of his royal blood after the curse is broken—Lena endures seven years of perilous hardships to locate the source of the Blood Spring and rescue her true love. Ultimately, they ascend the throne side by side, ruling over a kingdom where humans and vampires coexist. Yet, just as peace dawns, the sigil of an ancient witch quietly begins to glow red deep within the Blood Spring...

hades-mafia-princess.text: Born with the sealed bloodline of Hades, Lia Thorne is raised as the lost daughter of the wealthy Lancaster family. But when her return exposes their crimes and shatters their "lucky" adopted daughter Ava's perfect life, Lia is branded a curse. On her twelfth birthday, her parents drug her and leave her at Black Rose Manor, the most feared mafia estate in Black Bay. They expect her to die. Instead, mafia queen Veronica Knight and executioner Damian Wolf protect her as their little princess. As enemies close in, Lia's hidden power awakens, turning every betrayal into deadly karma.

knocked-up-by-the-wolf-duke.text: Shivon has spent her life dreaming of escaping her cruel family and earning a place at the Royal Academy. But after one reckless night with the mysterious Duke Alaric Blackmoor, she discovers she’s carrying the one thing everyone believed impossible—his child. Alaric was thought incapable of producing an heir, because a wolf can only conceive with his fated mate. Now, as Shivon’s family tries to sell her to the ruthless Lord Greyfang, Alaric will stop at nothing to find the woman who may be his one true mate—and protect the impossible heir growing inside her.

the-furless-one.text: Framed by her pack, Leila was thrown into the Howling Chasm and lost her arm. Two years later, her cruel family forces her to marry the North’s rumored “mad wolf,” Darian. But Darian is not mad—he is her fiercest protector. When her grandmother reveals that Leila is the true Alpha’s daughter, the impostor’s schemes collapse. Awakening her dormant wolf powers, Leila rejects her unworthy family and walks away with Darian into a new life under the blood moon.

second-chance-the-tech-billionaire-s-sec.text: Six years ago, heiress Milo left penniless Asher to save her failing family, keeping her pregnancy a secret. Now a ruthless tech billionaire still bitter about the past, Asher reunites with Milo at a gala — she’s now a desperate single mom, scrambling to pay for their son Leo’s life-saving heart surgery. As the truth of her sacrifice unfolds, a guilt-stricken Asher sets out to win her back, secures top care for their son, brings the real culprit to justice, and earns his second chance at love...

secret-dragon.text: On the continent of Vester, Iso—Supreme Ruler of the Hidden Dragon Dominion—goes into hiding under a humble identity to investigate his mother Saintess Esara's murder. Disguised as an ordinary man, he takes residence in Silvermoon Castle and, honoring an old betrothal, becomes the fiancé of Sera, heiress to the saintess lineage. Sera, however, is obsessed with the legendary Dragon Lord—a mythical figure she has worshipped from afar—and feels only disappointment toward her unremarkable-looking betrothed. She frequently mocks and belittles him, unaware of his true identity. Cardinal Taren of the Orthodox Church, coveting the saintess's power, secretly hires eight renowned Dragon Slayers and rallies noble conspirators to ambush and assassinate Sera time and again. Each time, Iso secretly intervenes, wielding his silver-dragon might to save her. At Dragon Ridge Altar, he finally reveals his true form as the Dragon Lord—yet Sera fails to recognize him. The perils continue: a tavern trap, a royal council coup, and a siege by dark Dragon Slayers—all quietly thwarted by Iso from the shadows. At the climactic final banquet, the Church launches its all-out assault. Iso summons a thousand dragons before the entire assembly, shattering the enemy's ranks. Only then does Sera realize that the "ordinary" fiancé who stood by her all along is the Dragon Lord she so longed to meet. Together, they join forces to counter the Church's conspiracy and uncover the truth behind the past.

the-duchess-they-cast-away.text: Born a commoner, Eleanor has spent years quietly protecting her husband, Duke Adrian, and his kingdom. Yet he has always mistaken her loyalty for ambition, believing she married him only for status and power. After being publicly humiliated and heartlessly cast aside by the man she loves, Eleanor finally gives up on their marriage and walks away. Only after she leaves does Adrian discover that the mysterious masked warrior who repeatedly saved his life was Eleanor all along. What he still does not know is that she is also the long-lost heir to a powerful empire. When Eleanor reclaims her identity and the power that rightfully belongs to her, Adrian finally realizes what he has lost. Meanwhile, an ambitious regent launches a coup, plunging the entire kingdom into crisis. With both his former wife and his realm in danger, Adrian is willing to sacrifice everything to protect Eleanor. But this time, he is no longer fighting to win back her love—only for the chance to earn her forgiveness.

scorched-heart.text: Samantha Hughes waited a whole year for AURA’s final farewell concert, only to find her childhood sweetheart Logan kissing Sierra outside the venue after giving away Sam’s VIP ticket. When Logan keeps choosing Sierra, exposes Sam’s family trauma, and later abandons her during a fire, Sam finally sees the boy she loved is gone. She withdraws from Berkeley, moves to New York, rebuilds her life with her mother, and refuses every attempt Logan makes to drag her back. Even when Sierra tries to ruin her reputation and Logan begs for another chance, Sam chooses peace, dignity, and a new love who actually stays.

vindication-blood-of-the-archmage.text: After his father dies saving the world, he is branded a traitor and his entire clan is destroyed. Ryan vanishes into exile, training in secret for fourteen years. Now Ryan returns to expose the dark mage's conspiracy, clear his father's name.

the-last-ace.text: twenty‑year‑ago, top gambler Alexander was framed by Calvin, losing everything and turned into a puppet. His daughter Ivy, abandoned back then, grows up with extraordinary gambling gifts. She heads to Las Vegas, gambles at the enemy’s casino, reunites with her birth mother and half‑brother. After deadly showdowns including a face‑off against her controlled father, Ivy kills the villain, settles old scores and rises as the new gambling god.

the-mafia-boss-s-contract-bride.text: Elena signed the divorce papers, penniless, wandering through the rain with her suitcase. A "Wanted: Stepmother" flyer on a deli bulletin board caught her attention. She followed the address, only to find that her employer turned out to be the Marchetti family, the most powerful mafia dynasty on the East Coast.

fleeing-the-future-i-saw-with-him.text: At a superpower‑fueled academy where strength reigns supreme, ordinary girl Sophie unexpectedly awakens the extremely rare ability of Future Sight. Yet the very first vision she sees of the future shows her locked in a passionate kiss with Damien, the campus’s cold‑hearted, sharp‑tongued student council president! Convinced this could never happen, Sophie is determined to keep her distance from him. But fate plays a cruel joke on her: that very same night, her mother remarries‑‑and Damien suddenly becomes her stepbrother. As the embrace and shared bed from her prophecy start coming true one after another, misunderstandings and romantic tension between them keep building amid their cohabitation and school life.

obsessed-by-my-ex-s-boss.text: On the day Beatrice catches her husband of eight years cheating, she quietly hands him divorce papers he signs without realizing — starting a thirty-day countdown to freedom. As she dismantles the Belmont family's schemes one by one, she is pulled into the orbit of Damian Crowley, her ex-husband's most feared cousin and the mysterious head of the NobleQuest Group. Revenge, a slow-burning romance, and a long-buried secret about a fire and her own origins begin to surface.

i-was-my-vampire-husband-s-dead-wife.text: Lord Julian Thornfield burns Adeline’s village, turns her into a vampire, and forces her to become his dead wife’s replacement. Even his daughter, Eve, calls her “Mama.” When Adeline tries to die, Eve’s strange power hurls them a hundred years into the past. There, Julian is not a cruel lord yet. He is a scarred human slave in a circus cage, whipped as a monster. Adeline only wants to hand Eve back and escape, but the child’s broken heart ties her to them both. Then the caged man asks who she is, and Adeline answers, “I’m your future wife.”

the-billionaire-parents-final-test.text: To discover who truly loves them, wealthy couple Hannah and her husband fake bankruptcy, with him pretending to be paralyzed after a stroke. Their test exposes the truth: their biological son Thomas and his wife refuse to help and turn them away, while adopted son Theo and his wife give up everything to save him. After learning the truth, Hannah and her husband leave their $50 million fortune to Theo. Thomas loses everything and finally realizes that true family is built on love, not blood.

the-boy-raised-me-is-mine.text: Iris’s mother, who had immigrated to the United States from Thailand as part of a blended family, died in a car accident along with her American husband while they were on their way to get married. Unwilling to see Iris deported, her stepfather’s son, Leon, dropped out of school to work on a construction site and shoulder the financial burden; as they relied on each other, the two grew close. After graduating from high school, Iris was accepted into a New York law school, just as she had hoped. Leon promised to join her, but on the very last day, he was involved in an accident at the construction site, and the two lost contact. Five years later, Iris joined a top-tier law firm, and Leon walked through the doors as a billionaire client—reuniting the two.

the-inferno-warlord-s-secret-healer-brid.text: Four years ago, healer Seraphina saved cursed Infernal Legion commander Drake and gave birth to twins. Unaware of his identity, she was exiled by her family and raised the children alone. Years later, the wounded Drake is found by the kids and brought home. He falls for Seraphina at first sight and proposes firmly. Amid stepmother's persecution, brother's power grab and dark magic crisis, they uncover the truth of their past. Finally Drake inherits the Lord of the North, and the family of four lives happily together.

daughter-of-the-four-norse-god-kings.text: Evelyn was once the beloved human daughter of four mighty Norse god-kings. But when the false saintess Freya framed her, the fathers who raised her chose to believe a liar. They stripped her blessing, tortured her soul, stole her blood, and forced her to beg for death. Only after Evelyn truly dies do they discover the truth: Freya was the monster all along, and Evelyn's real mother has been trapped beneath the World Tree. Now the gods want their daughter back. But the little girl they destroyed no longer wants to return.

after-the-330-pound-fat-wolf-left-the-al.text: Nia is a 300-pound Omega mocked by the entire pack as a disgusting fat wolf. When Alpha Zayne chooses her as his Luna, she believes she has finally been loved. She poisons herself, bleeds for him, tears her own fur to keep him warm, and carries his child. Then she overhears the truth: Zayne only used her as a womb and plans to kill her after the baby is born. Betrayed, abused, and forced through unbearable trials, Nia awakens as a legendary White Wolf. Now she returns under a new name, not for love, but to save the child Zayne killed. The Alpha finally falls in love with her beauty, but the woman who once loved him has already died.

blood-rose-crushing-the-cartel.text: Desperate to pay for her sick mother’s treatment, restaurant waitress Anna is betrayed by her biological father, Richard, and sent into a deadly trap controlled by an East Side crime boss. Using her combat skills and intelligence, she survives, defeats Victor, and escapes with crucial evidence. With the help of Leo, an undercover operative and Thomas’s son, Anna rises through Los Angeles’ criminal underworld, taking control of casinos and territory. But she soon discovers that her entire rise has been part of Thomas’s larger power game. Together, Anna and Leo expose the money-laundering operation and bring down Thomas and Richard.

love-in-my-hands.text: Yeonju joins Perfect Match, a survival dating show where several men compete for one woman’s heart. Moving into the “Match House,” she begins a seven-day experiment in love — a whirlwind of unexpected chemistry and temptation. From poolside challenges and secret touches to one-night dates, each day brings new excitement, new connections… and new betrayals. As emotions blur between sincerity and strategy, passion and hesitation, Yeonju finds herself sinking deeper into a storm of desire and confusion. With every elimination and every choice she makes, her heart grows heavier — until the final day, when her decision will shape one of five completely different endings. Who will you choose to complete your story of love?

love-has-a-deadline.text: Five years after breaking up with his college sweetheart Nora, successful ad man Ben unexpectedly reunites with her as his new partner at work. But whenever Ben reveals his true feelings, his consciousness is thrown back five years into his younger self. Determined to fix the mistakes that ended their relationship, Ben begins rewriting the past—only to discover that every change can reshape the present. To win Nora back, he must finally face the one thing he has always avoided: telling her the truth.

bound-by-crimson-and-silver.text: Aria, a human teenage girl, suddenly finds herself homeless after her family goes bankrupt. She's forced to live in her car, a shameful secret she needs to hide from the vicious bullies at her elite private high school. One day, she discovers that she's the mate of both Damon, the werewolf heir, and Levi, the vampire prince. These two supernaturally handsome boys have opposite personalities. One as passionate as fire, and the latter as cold as ice. Which one is her true love? Aria later discovers that there's more to her real identity than she thought. It's a secret that could destroy everything.

goodbye-my-ex-i-m-marrying-the-dragon-pr.text: Mira is the long-lost biological daughter of the Hale family of Ashen City. Yet after returning home, she repeatedly gives way to their adopted daughter, Lia—surrendering her room, her place as a dragon rider, and even half of her mother’s inheritance. Before the wedding, Draegoth—the bonded dragon Garrick personally tamed and the only keepsake Mira has left from her mother—is trained to obey Lia alone and nearly kills Mira. Realizing that Garrick, her fiancé of eight years, has always seen her as nothing more than a gullible woman, Mira walks barefoot across burning coals, breaks off their engagement, and turns to marry Theron, the Lord of the North, who has waited eight years for her. When Garrick, Lia, and Mira’s brother Cael arrive at the magnificent Northern wedding and discover that Mira is the bride, they are overwhelmed with regret—but it is already too late. In the end, Mira is surrounded by the love she deserves, and her mother’s dragon finally returns to her side.

i-watched-them-love-her.text: Tessa is pushed off a building by her adopted sister Chloe. She wakes up at fifteen, reliving her life. This time, she refuses to fight for her family's love. Chloe manipulates everyone, framing Tessa for cheating. Tessa calmly proves Chloe's guilt using surveillance footage. Chloe is expelled. Tessa earns straight A's and a Yale scholarship. Her family apologizes, but she remains distant. She leaves for Yale alone, determined to live for herself.

firefighter-husband-burned-his-daughter-.text: A firefighter sets his own home ablaze for his mistress’s drill, trapping his three-year-old daughter inside. The mother watches via security cam, but he dismisses her pleas, calls the child illegitimate, and prioritizes the assessment. As flames consume the nursery, the daughter’s ghost emerges—still apologizing for being “bad.” Only when charred remains, a melted necklace, and final recordings surface does he break down. But forgiveness never comes. The daughter’s last words: “Daddy didn’t love me.” He is arrested; she fades into ash, finally free.

after-i-took-back-my-love.text: After a painful rebirth, Eleanor, once a devoted wife and mother, finds her family's affection reserved for Lydia, her husband William's true love. Betrayed by William's bigamy and her children's cruelty, she abandons them, secretly applying to Harvard. As she builds a new life in science, William and the children, now suffering under Lydia's abuse, realize their loss. They beg for forgiveness, but Eleanor, hardened by their betrayal, coldly rejects them. Choosing her own path, she leaves them behind to embrace a future of independence and self-worth.

clumsy-cupid.text: Eva, a cold-blooded assassin, accidentally triggers a deadly curse after killing the man chosen as her soulmate. Her only chance of survival is Leo—a clumsy Cupid apprentice who has failed his divine exam for ten thousand years. Bound by an invisible life thread, they must stay within three meters of each other or die. With only seven days left, the mismatched pair is forced to run from a powerful assassin organization while uncovering a conspiracy that has been manipulating love itself. Eva has never trusted anyone. But when Leo repeatedly risks his life to save hers, she must decide whether love is her greatest weakness—or her only way out.

the-quarterback-s-secret-darling.text: Asher secretly dated QB Chase for six months. Chase never went public—instead he played the perfect couple with Asher's sister Daisy. A naked photo of Asher leaked across campus. Daisy stole it from Chase's phone. Chase told Asher to stay quiet and kept using him. Hockey captain Finn opened Instagram in front of everyone: “Want to date? Follow me first.” Next day, he held Asher's hand in the hallway—fingers laced, for everyone to see. Daisy faked a nut allergy attack to frame Asher. Asher shoved her head into a fountain. Chase lost his game and screamed at Daisy on the sideline—his golden image shattered. Finn won, looked at the camera, and said: “Our goalie held two periods alone. I didn't want him carrying it alone anymore.” Everyone understood.
